fade_to.name: Fade to position
fade_to.description: Moves the room along its curve to a position. Every light follows its own staggered curve on the way.

position.name: Position
position.description: Target position on the room's 0–100 scale. 0 turns everything off.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the fade takes, e.g. one hour for a wake-up light. Defaults to the room's default transition.

stop.name: Stop fade
stop.description: Stops a running fade and keeps all lights where they currently are.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reloads all Cloudless Crescendo lights from YAML.
